title: Startup Gets $400M Loan Backed by AI Chips, Not Cash
description:
So a startup just took a loan backed by AI chips instead of cash 😅 Upper Ninety gave General Compute $400M, and the collateral is SambaNova processors, they run ready models 16x faster then GPUs with no water cooling. The market is splitting now: pricey GPUs for training, cheap chips just to run models. AI compute keeps getting cheaper 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
